listen_addr.description: Local host address to bind to. If omitted, defaults to 0.0.0.0. Used with -l flag if specified explicitly.

listen_port.description: Local TCP port to listen on.

target_port.description: Remote TCP port to connect to.

use_ipv6.description: If true, passes the -6 flag to listen on an IPv6 address instead of the default IPv4.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections (passing -L flag). 0 means unlimited.

force_resolve.description: If true, passes the -f flag to force tunneling even if the remote host is not resolvable at execution time.

once.description: If true, passes the -1 flag to exit after the first connection.

no_detach.description: If true, passes the -d flag to prevent detaching from the console (foreground mode).

user.description: Username to switch to after binding (passes -u flag). 6tunnel must be run as root to use this.

source_addr.description: Source address to connect from (passes -s flag).

map_file.description: Path to the map file for binding IPv6 addresses based on source IPv4 addresses (passes -m flag).

pid_file.description: Path to the file where the PID will be written (passes -p flag).
